intro.title: Python data model
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple Python program that demonstrates the core principles of the Python data model by creating and manipulating custom objects. You will learn how Python treats everything as an object and how special methods like __init__, __str__, and __repr__ define object behavior. The main technologies involved are Python classes, special methods (dunder methods), and built-in functions. By the end, you will understand how the data model enables consistent interactions with objects across the language.
intro.usecase: The Python data model is fundamental to building robust applications like e-commerce platforms, where custom objects represent products with attributes like price, inventory, and reviews. In data science workflows, it enables creating specialized data structures for analysis pipelines, ensuring consistent behavior across operations. Web frameworks like Django use the data model extensively to define database models with validation and relationships. Understanding this model helps developers write cleaner, more maintainable code when designing APIs, handling user sessions, or implementing business logic in applications like inventory management systems or social media platforms.
